MRI Information
The Zephyr Pacemaker System is MR Conditional. A person with the Zephyr Pacemaker System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Zephyr Pacemaker System
Device Configuration Stimulation OFF
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T or 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 720 G/cm (7.2 T/m)
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
RF Transmit Coil Type Body transmit coil or head transmit coil
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 1 W/kg
Scan Duration Limit total active scanning to 30 min.
Scan Regions Exclusion zone: do not position the isocenter between the C7 vertebra and the iliac crest
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 7 mm from the device.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
